13.0.0.rawName: Edge of a Field, Near the Gates of Arkane
13.0.0.rawDesc:
As you stand at the eastern edge of the field, surrounded on the north
and south by forest, the incessant giggling continues.  From here you must
decide whether to investigate the giggling, head west toward the coast, or
tread eastward to the city of Arkane.

14.0.0.rawDesc:
The shiny gates of Arkane lie before you, tall and imposing.  You can see
guards on the other side of the gates, milling about silently, waiting for
something to happen.  A road trails off to the west, to the horizon, while a
small paved path leads into the frontier city of Arkane.  To the north and
south is an extended clearing which provides excellent visibility for the
guards.

15.0.0.rawDesc:
The path intersects here to the north, south, east and west.  The paths to 
the north and south run along the city walls, while off to the east you can
see the heart of the city.  The gentle sound of conversation buzzes your 
ears, none of it discernible as it all drowns together in a myriad of 
sound.

16.0.0.rawDesc:
The path you are on continues to the east and west from here, cobbled and 
stable.  The sounds of indescriminant conversation float about on the 
gentle breeze.  The smells of food drift in from the south.  Small 
buildings can be seen to the north and south.

17.0.0.rawDesc:
Main Street continues to the east and west along a cobbled path.  The path 
veers off to the north from here, along a shadowy alley where you can 
faintly see the sign for a tavern, swinging lackadaisically in the breeze.  
The sounds of blacksmith also drift in from the north, barely audible over 
the other sounds of the city.

18.0.0.rawDesc:
The cobbled street you are on continues to the east and west.  Small 
buildings seem to blend into one another to the north, each of them 
indescriminant from the next.  Arkane's finest restaurant blocks your 
vision to the south as the smells of fine food drift over Main Street 
carried on the gentle breeze.

19.0.0.rawDesc:
Main Street continues off to the east and west from here, along its
cobbled path.  Buildings sit off to the north and south, but no entrance can
be seen from here.  The center of town can be seen off to the east down the
road a ways.  Off to the west, the town entrance is visible with a
shimmering doorway appearing to the south, with a sign up above.

20.0.0.rawDesc:
The small cobbled road continues to the east and west.  Buildings rise to 
the north and south, yet no doors are visible, only windows.  To the north 
you see a tavern, dimly lit, the ceiling of the first floor covered in 
smoke.  To the south you see people dining in a nice restaurant, talking 
idly, their voiced not audible through the glass panes.

21.0.0.rawDesc:
From the center of Arkane, you can go to the north, east and west.  The
porch of the Fellowship Saloon is accessable to the south.  Off in the other
directions, the town gates can be seen, tall and imposing.  An arena rises
up to the northwest.

21.1.0.rawName: On the Porch of the Fellowship Saloon
21.1.0.rawDesc:
The porch is made of wood, and smells of old beer and sweat.  There are a
couple elves sitting around on old wooden stools, sipping wine and smoking
long curving pipes.  There are a few dirty windows which peer into the large
building to the south, from which flickering light can be seen.  Laughing and
some singing can be heard from within the large doorway.

21.2.0.rawName: In the Main Gathering Room of the Fellowship Saloon
21.2.0.rawDesc:
The room is large, loud, and filled with smoke.  To the north a rectangle
of light can be seen where the door stands.  In the center of the room,
there is a long bar, where a large plump lady stands serving drinks.  She
often smacks some of the more rowdy drunks on the head as she bustles around
serving her drinks.  There is a group of Minotaurs arm wrestling some ogres
at one table near what looks to be pieces of a few more tables.  Over in the
corner, you see a kender giving a speach about some adventure to a large
group of humans who are mainly ignoring him.  You can see an doorway into a
dimly lit room to the east, another doorway to the west, and a stairway
leading upstairs.  


You can read a large sign hanging above the bar, written in common, with
about 30 other languages translated in small letters below it.  It reads
"Welcome Friend".

20.2.0.rawDesc:
The meeting room is a gathering place, where people can discuss things
ranging from the latest gossip, to important political matters.  A large
wooden table occupies the room, with room enough to seat more than twenty
people.  A large fire burns in a fireplace nearby, and there is a serving
woman nearby, ready to serve all the drinks needed for those who meet within
the room.

22.2.0.rawName: A Small Side Room of the Fellowship Saloon
22.2.0.rawDesc:
This room is made for smaller gatherings of people, meetings, or just
friendly conversation.  There are some bar stools scattered around, and a
waitress stands here serving drinks to people.  The walls are covered with
paintings and portraits with signatures from famous people all through
Algoron.  You can see a portrait of Solestri and another of Mito adorning
the walls.

21.2.1.rawDesc:
Smooth wooden walls line the passage, glistening with a dull sheen.  The
smell of oil and wax further enhance the cleanliness of the often-washed
surfaces, yet faint stains still show their marks in the wood, common in any
tavern amongst the small dents and chips.  Brightly painted doors surround
you, each emitting a soft light that matches the color of the door, casting
an eerie glow in the hallway.  To the north a light blue door is accented
with white clouds that move slowly across the painted surface.  To the east
stands a bright red door with a animted image of a luxurious carriage.  To
the south, another blue door, this one darker and moving like the others,
small pieces of seaweed quickly growing until they reach halfway up the door
only to disappear and begin anew as tiny fish swim amongst them.  The dark
black door to the west appears void of any designs, and instead it emits a
rhythmic pulsing sensation.  Each door has a set of runes carved into the
center, a soft hum created by the magic held therein.  


A delicate, narrow staircase ascends upwards to a plain wooden door on the
third story of the building.  A small sign near the base of the polished,
wooden steps reads: [0;36mPlease place the purchased runes in the corresponding
door.  Wait until they glow bright [0;37msilver[0;36m and then lightly push against the
door.  If you experience any trouble with the doors (or the gully dwarf),
please contact the management at the top of these stairs.  [0m

21.-1.0.rawDesc:
A sign to the east indicates the Arkanian Bakery.  Children fill up this
section of the alley in an attempt to get into the bakery which smells of
delicious and wonderful baked goods and pastries.  To the south you can see
Arkane's Town Center.  A small lottery store has been opened to the west.

21.-2.0.rawDesc:
From the smells of it, the town florist resides to the east as you glance over
her floral display in the window.  The backside of the tavern lies off to the 
west, while Main Street dances with activity to the south.  Also to the south 
you see a horde of children trying to get into a store.

21.-3.0.rawDesc:
A sign hanging on the building to the east indicates it as the utility
shop of Arkane.  From the south you can hear the sounds of Main Street while
off to the north you can see the north gate of Arkane.  More stores line the
alley to the southeast.  To the west lies "Arkane Fur Importers".

21.-4.0.rawDesc:
The north gate of Arkane rises before you, shiny and tall.  You watch as 
people go in and out of the town freely, walking on a road that carries them 
off into the distance.  To the east and west Echelon Way continues, while back 
to the south is an alley.
 
A church rises up from the southwest.

21.-5.0.rawDesc:
To the south you can enter Arkane.  The wilderness of the continent lies off 
in all the other directions.  A soft breeze carries the smells of the city's 
bakery.  Inside the gate you can see the people of the town and travelers 
from distant lands.

22.0.0.rawDesc:
Off to your west, the sounds of the busy Town Center can be heard as
people rush about, sometimes brushing up against you in order to get by.  An
imposing building lies off to the south, casting a dark shadow at its base
that extends out to the street.  To the north lies "Grokk's Leather
Crafting" and to the south lies "Whitetail Leather Goods".

23.0.0.rawDesc:
Main street continues to run to the east and west of here, each to their 
own prospective gates.  An alley runs to the north, drowned in shadow as 
the large buildings to the east and west of the alley stand tall.  Smells 
of baked bread fill the air off to the north or northwest, it is hard to 
discern.

24.0.0.rawDesc:
Large buildings rise to the north and south of you while Main Street 
continues off to the east and west.  A temple lies off to the north, 
perhaps the tallest building in the town, while Arkane's finest restaurant 
stands proudly to the south.

25.0.0.rawDesc:
Guild Row has been built up to the south of Main Street here.  The newly
laid cobblestones look quite even, and the various guild houses well-kept. 
A small well rests at the end of the cul-de-sac to the south, and Main
Street continues to the east and west here.  To the north lies the
Orphanage.

26.0.0.rawDesc:
The large eastern gate of Arkane lies off to the east as you notice guards 
taking their posts.  Way off to the west the western gates can be seen 
vaguely shimmering in the light.  Various scents float about the air each 
of them distinctive from one another: food, flowers, dust.  People mill about 
casually watching you with sidelong glances. 
 
The smell of bacon wafts from the south where a Cafe can be seen.

27.0.0.rawDesc:
Main Street continues to the west, while a small alley runs to the north and 
south of here, along the perimeter of the city.  People filter in and out of 
the city through the gate to the east, which is guarded by the protectors of 
the town.

28.0.0.rawDesc:
The city of Arkane lies off to the west of you, through massive gates. 
To the northeast, you can see the Great Forest, the largest forest on the
continent.  Inside the city, you can see the people of the town, and
especially imposing is the temple of Arkane, who's spires dwarf the other
buildings in the city.  A game trail leads off to the southeast away from
the city and into the woods.  To the north and south is an extended clearing
which provides excellent visibility for the guards.

29.0.0.rawDesc:
Towering gates loom to the west, allowing entry into Arkane.  Ambient
noise murmurs over the gates from the bustling city.  The ornate and well
kempt ground quickly fades into a rough road heading east.  Ruts from supply
carts scar the ground and widen down the slope eastward.
